bodyAnchors: All54 unmounted source slots retain the exact original body height and lowest-pixel Y. Horizontal centers are rounded to the nearest native pixel; silhouettes have reviewed width differences.
cellPlacement: Cell rectangles were repacked around unchanged indexed source pixels. They retain the native4/8-cell budgets, signed XY encoding and authored body/effect anchors; cell rectangles are not claimed identical to the original tile partition.
coverage: Every opaque body/effect pixel is covered; hidden overlapping rider cells remain independently encoded and tested.
